title: EvoQuantLab: Training-Free Dual-Loop Evolution for Auditable Quantitative Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.17130v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated alpha factor discovery is critical for modern quantitative research. While large language models (LLMs) have increasingly been integrated into quantitative workflows, existing agent-based approaches remain highly susceptible to severe backtest overfitting. To address this challenge, we propose EvoQuantLab, a training-free, dual-loop self-evolving framework for robust factor discovery. Instead of relying entirely on LLM generation, EvoQuantLab deploys an inner genetic-programming (GP) loop that dramatically improves token efficiency while evolving typed factor expressions under structural and diversity constraints. An outer diagnosis loop then systematically audits evidence across cycles to drive protocol-level improvements. Furthermore, our evaluation pipeline applies multi-metric validation to rigorously filter out spurious factors before deployment. Extensive out-of-sample experiments across both daily and hourly frequencies

translated_title: EvoQuantLab：面向可审计量化研究的免训练双循环进化框架
translated_abstract: 自动化Alpha因子发现对现代量化研究至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLM）已日益融入量化工作流程，但现有的基于智能体的方法仍然极易受到严重的回测过拟合影响。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了EvoQuantLab，一个用于稳健因子发现的免训练双循环自进化框架。EvoQuantLab并非完全依赖LLM生成，而是部署了内部遗传编程（GP）循环，在结构与多样性约束下进化类型化因子表达式，同时显著提升了token效率。随后，外部诊断循环系统性地审计跨周期的证据，以驱动协议层面的改进。此外，我们的评估流程采用多指标验证，在部署前严格过滤掉虚假因子。在日频与小时频数据上广泛的样本外实验……
tldr: 提出免训练双循环自进化框架EvoQuantLab，通过遗传编程内循环与大模型诊断外循环及多指标验证，实现稳健、可审计的Alpha因子自动发现并有效抑制回测过拟合。
en_tdlr: EvoQuantLab is a training-free dual-loop self-evolving framework that combines an inner genetic-programming loop with an outer diagnosis loop and multi-metric validation to achieve robust, auditable automated alpha factor discovery while mitigating severe backtest overfitting.
